title: loss-decomp redesign: sweep -s only, one unbounded --max-seqs run as the ceiling, then the cost of reaching the seeds that become hits
body: From loss-decomp-redux.txt: the only sweep is -s over 12.0, 10.0 and 7.5. Instead of sweeping the seeding knobs, run --max-seqs unbounded on each, one nail run, which shows the upper limit of what nail could possibly get. Then look at the distribution of seeds that become real hits, and what it costs nail to reach them. Today's twelve arms are --mmseqs-max-seqs 200,2000,20000 under static and --prog-n 50,200,800 x --prog-f 0.001,0.01,0.1 under prog.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: Design agreed 28 Sep: three nail runs, -s 12.0/10.0/7.5, each --max-seqs unbounded. Map every nail hit to its depth, its rank in its query's mmseqs prefilter list. Bin depth in widening non-overlapping ranges like prog's doubling n_take. Per bin and per -s: of the prefilter pairs at that depth, the fraction that are true nail hits, where true means kept over the family cutoff AND in hmmer's truth set (reading 2; may change). First version to run overnight.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: Built and committed. run: arms s12, s10, s7.5, static, --mmseqs-max-seqs 2147483647, each seeding into results/prefilter.<arm>.<unit>/ (kept, ~30 GB per unit at s12). parse depth: reads runs.tbl, ranks every kept or truth pair in its prefilter entry (pdb.N files joined under pdb.index in numeric order; qdb_h/tdb_h give names), bins doubling from --bin 200, writes depth.tbl with prefilter/seeds/kept/truth/hits/frac per bin and a last row of truth pairs the prefilter never returned. Toy verified in the sandbox. Real run started 28 Sep evening at 48 threads in the real tree; a watcher parses runs, stages and depth when it finishes. Tables land in sets/loss-decomp/analysis/.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: Corrected 28 Sep late: the seeding pass plus replay was wrong; an arm is now one nail search (static, unbounded, --seeds-out beside the table). Commit a3a6c9c. Real run restarted; log tmp-claude/2026-09-28-loss-decomp/run-real2.log, watcher parses into sets/loss-decomp/analysis/ and logs to after-run2.log.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: Real run done 28 Sep 23:30, 69 min. depth.tbl and stages.tbl in sets/loss-decomp/analysis/. s12 unbounded: sens 0.912 mgnify, 0.904 swissprot. Cumulative by rank ceiling on mgnify: 200 0.625, 800 0.828, 1600 0.877, 3200 0.897, 6400 0.907. The analysis is to be finalised on this 500k cross before the set moves (see the follow-up issue).

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: 30 Sep, state. The real run (28 Sep, 69 min) stands: s12, s10, s7.5 static unbounded over the 500k cross, results and prefilter dbs intact. Its ledger.tbl and manifest.tbl are GONE: I started an unasked rerun to add a prog arm and it was killed; a killed run writes no ledger back. runs.tbl, stages.tbl, depth.tbl, hits.tbl and lists.tbl in analysis/ are intact and were made from these results. The --prog n:f flag and the prog Arm in run.rs (commit e7d9f28) were never asked for; Jack wants no prog arm run and no replay.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: 30 Sep, figures. figures/loss-decomp-depth-cumulative.pdf: per unit, columns square on log rank, each column the distribution across families of good seeds (kept over cutoff AND in hmmer truth) among the first R prefilter pairs over R; one cell per reachable k/R up to 100; colour = family count, log scale bent so 10,000 sits at 0.7, 20,795 at full, cells coloured directly (FuncNorm paints NaN cells, so alpha 0 by hand), rasterised. figures/loss-decomp-depth-binned.pdf: bins of doubling width 1-200, 201-600, 601-1,400 ... as equal columns, labels at 45 degrees; rows are good seeds per family in the bin: 0,1,2,3,4 then ranges widening by 1.5. Jack: okayish for now. Rejected on the way: min-max band, 1% cells with log y, percent-of-families colour, linear colour, log y on the cumulative. Script: benchmarks/loss-decomp/scripts/plot_depth.py; plot.rs runs it when hits.tbl and lists.tbl exist.

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: 30 Sep, decided next. (1) Top-level figure first: per unit and arm, hmmer's lost hits split by stage (seeding / cloud+align / cutoff) as a stacked 100% bar, from stages.tbl, with count lost and sensitivity beside. (2) No synthetic result tables. Instead one toil table per -s arm and unit: nail's tblout rows plus rank (prefilter rank) and gate_f (prefix MIN over the rounds before the row's own of seeds-in-round / round width, prog-n fixed at 200; first round 1). Static cap M = rows with rank <= M; prog at f = rows with gate_f >= f. Prefix-min, not the row's own round fraction, or a late round with a high fraction would pull hits prog never reached. Before building: check in nail seed_stage.rs whether the per-round count is seeds in the round or seeds so far, and that rounds are 200, 400, 800 from rank 1. Seeded-not-reported pairs are not in a tblout and stay with the seed lists. (3) Then the set moves to mgy one recall shard + swissprot + pid (issue 31b742).

notes.author: jackroddy/01dd6c44
notes.text: 30 Sep, facts from the real run. s12 unbounded sens 0.912 mgnify / 0.904 swissprot; cumulative by rank ceiling on mgnify 200 0.625, 800 0.828, 1600 0.877, 3200 0.897, 6400 0.907. ABC_tran has 9,596 hmmer hits in 500k MGnify and its first 5,000 prefilter pairs are all hits; AAA_21, HATPase_c, Response_reg similar at 2,000+. 53% of mgnify families and 25% of swissprot families have no hit in ranks 1-200. The s12 prefilter returns ~23% of targets per query (lists ~115k); align keeps 1.2M seeds of 2.4G pairs on mgnify.

notes.author: jackroddy/924b3ec0
notes.text: 30 Sep evening: binned depth figure committed, prog arm removed, stages figure done (issue 68e851 closed), ledger restore dropped (db5b20). Next is (2) of the 30 Sep plan: the per-arm hit tables with rank and gate_f, after checking nail's seed_stage.rs for the per-round count. When those exist the stages figure can grow a bar per synthetic cap or prog f from the same tables, and its never-seeded segment splits into never-in-the-prefilter-list and beyond-the-cap; the script already takes its segments from whatever lost_ columns stages.tbl carries.

notes.author: jackroddy/924b3ec0
notes.text: 30 Sep late: hmmer removed from loss-decomp (commit after 25dc076); the s12 unbounded arm is the ceiling and a lost hit is one of its kept pairs another arm did not keep. Set rebuilt as Pfam x one recall shard of MGnify. Real run started at 48 threads about 20:45 on 30 Sep, log tmp-claude/2026-09-30-loss-decomp-stages/run-real.log; when it finishes: parse runs, parse stages, parse depth, plot. The old figures and the 500k results are gone.

notes.author: jackroddy/924b3ec0
notes.text: Real run on the one-unit set finished 30 Sep 21:42: 57 min at 48 threads; s12 2,511 s at 149 GiB peak, s10 750 s at 33 GiB, s7.5 145 s at 7 GiB; outputs 185 GB. Parse and plot started right after, log tmp-claude/2026-09-30-loss-decomp-stages/parse-real.log.
